title: Vision-Language Models for Autonomous Driving
description: Build multimodal perception models that fuse camera imagery with natural-language scene descriptions to improve pedestrian and hazard detection for campus autonomous shuttles. Work spans dataset curation, transformer fine-tuning and closed-loop simulation evaluation.
skills: Python; PyTorch; Computer Vision; Deep Learning

title: Smart Grid Load Forecasting with Time-Series ML
description: Develop forecasting models for campus and regional electricity demand using historical sensor streams. Projects include feature engineering for weather data, probabilistic forecasting, and deployment of dashboards for utility partners.
skills: Python; Pandas; Machine Learning; Time Series
eligibility: Electrical Engineering, Industrial Systems Engineering, Sophomore+

title: Human-Robot Interaction for Assistive Robotics
description: Design and evaluate collaborative robot behaviors that help older adults with daily tasks. Involves ROS-based control code, motion planning, and user studies measuring trust and workload.

title: Genomic Data Pipelines for Precision Agriculture
description: Analyze plant and livestock genomic datasets to identify markers linked to drought resilience. Tasks include variant calling, statistical association testing and reproducible pipeline engineering on high-performance computing clusters.

title: Usable Security: Evaluating Password Manager UX
description: Run mixed-methods human subjects studies on how non-experts adopt password managers. Involves survey and interview design, qualitative coding, usability testing and lightweight analysis scripts for behavioral logs.
skills: Human-Computer Interaction; Survey Design; Python; Statistics

title: Reinforcement Learning for Drone Swarm Coordination
description: Train multi-agent reinforcement learning policies that let aerial robot teams survey disaster zones cooperatively. Emphasis on reward shaping, high-fidelity simulation and sim-to-real transfer.

title: LLM-Based Tutoring Chatbot for CS1 Courses
description: Build and evaluate a retrieval-augmented large language model tutor that gives programming hints without revealing solutions. Work covers prompt engineering, natural language processing evaluation, and a small web front end for students.

title: Thermal Management for Electric Vehicle Battery Packs
description: Model heat generation and cooling strategies for lithium-ion battery modules. Includes finite element thermal simulation, experimental validation on instrumented test benches and design optimization of cold plates.
skills: MATLAB; Finite Element Analysis; Thermodynamics; Mechanical Design
